capabilities.name: Bash Doors
capabilities.description: Monster can bash through closed doors.

capabilities.name: Kill Walls
capabilities.description: Monster can destroy walls while moving.

capabilities.name: Move Body
capabilities.description: Monster can push weaker monsters aside.

capabilities.name: Kill Body
capabilities.description: Monster can destroy weaker monsters blocking its path.

capabilities.name: Invisible
capabilities.description: Monster is invisible to normal sight.

capabilities.name: Cold-Blooded
capabilities.description: Monster is cold-blooded and does not leave warm-blood traces.

capabilities.name: Hurt by Light
capabilities.description: Monster is harmed by bright light, as with the original HURT_LITE flag.

capabilities.name: Hurt by Rock Removal
capabilities.description: Monster is harmed when rock is removed around it, as with the original HURT_ROCK flag.

capabilities.name: Powerful
capabilities.description: Monster is powerful; its breath attacks use the larger radius associated with the original POWERFUL flag.

capabilities.name: Never Move
capabilities.description: Monster never moves from its grid position, as with the original NEVER_MOVE flag.

capabilities.name: Never Blow
capabilities.description: Monster never makes melee blows, as with the original NEVER_BLOW flag.

capabilities.name: Destroy Items
capabilities.description: Monster destroys items it encounters, as with the original KILL_ITEM flag.
